summary.en: Professor Agasa, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys attend a firefly festival to commemorate a shinto shrine in a small mountain village of Kofu, Yamanashi Prefecture. The truck soon arrives with the fireflies and they are released into the fields. Later one of the truck drivers, Tokuro Nakamine, is found murdered and three of the villagers are the prime suspects.

suspects: Aoi Owada, Tatsuma Kashiwa, and Shuichiro Tarumi
